author: felicepantaleo
body:
This PR changes `TICLCandidate` and adds a new product class, `ticl::InterpretationHypotheses`. Both are used by the TICLv6 interpretation and candidate producers, which come in later PRs; this PR has no producer that fills the new members or the new class.

`TICLCandidate` (ClassVersion 4 to 5):
- New member `typeProbabilities_` with `typeProbabilities()`, `typeProbability(type)` and `setTypeProbabilities(...)`: the probability of each candidate type from the interpretation stage, in the order of `ParticleType`. It is 0 when not set, so it is 0 for every candidate of the current reconstruction.
- The PID probabilities (`idProbabilities_`) and the new type probabilities are stored as 16-bit integers: 65535 is 1, a value is rounded to the nearest step of 1/65535, values below 0 and NaN are stored as 0, and values above 1 as 65535. The size of the class does not change (8 floats before, 2 x 8 uint16 now).
- `idProbabilities()` and `typeProbabilities()` now return the decoded values by value, not a const reference. All callers in master compile unchanged.
- A read rule converts the float `idProbabilities_` of files written with ClassVersion 3 and 4.
- New `appendTrackster(...)`: it adds a trackster and keeps the candidate time (`addTrackster` also takes the trackster time).
- All data members have default member initializers. The constructor from charge and momentum now also sets the MTD time to 0 and its error to -1; before, these two members had no value.

`ticl::InterpretationHypotheses` (ClassVersion 3): the competing hypotheses of the TICLv6 interpretation stage (type, tracks, footprint energy and barycenter, weight, accepted flag), their conflicts and the solver settings, so that an analysis can read the decisions of the stage. The tracks of all hypotheses are stored in one vector with offsets.

Effect on current output: the stored PID probabilities of `ticlCandidate` and `hltTiclCandidate` are rounded to steps of 1/65535. Readers of `id_probability`, for example `TICLDumper` and the `TICLCandidateValidator` histograms, see these rounded values.
title: DataFormats/HGCalReco: type probabilities in TICLCandidate, and the interpretation hypotheses
